notes.subject: כבתולה על בעל נעוריה
notes.rationale: 'Virgin for the husband of her youth' — betrothed young woman mourning a bridegroom who never came, vs reading as widowed young wife.

notes.subject: to Jerusalem/Judah
notes.rationale: Direct address commanding lament; addressee implied from context, the people.

notes.subject: שק
notes.rationale: Sackcloth rendered as sok bilong krai, coarse mourning cloth, keeping its literal shape.

translation: Krai olsem gel meri i narapela taim i marit, i tarimim sok bilong krai long man bilong klostu taim bilong en i yangpela yet.
